summary: Comprehensive testing of the Paid Leave HRMS enhancement (checkbox model, stored balance, admin Paid Leave Management tab, generate/import/export/history, reserve->approve/reject flow, mutual monthly lock). 14/14 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend admin flow verified via Playwright: /leave shows the new tab-paid-leave; the Paid Leave Management panel exposes all required data-testids (pl-month-select, pl-year-select, pl-status-banner, pl-generate-btn, pl-export-xlsx-btn, pl-export-csv-btn, pl-import-btn, pl-history-btn). The Apply-for-Employee dialog shows the admin-consider-paid-checkbox and no longer offers 'Paid' as a leave type (Sick/Emergency/Preplanned/Optional only). History dialog opens fine. Legacy 'Paid' leave type is intentionally retained ONLY in the top filter dropdown (Leave.js:383) for historical filtering, matching the spec ('keep legacy Paid records untouched in history'). All test-created data cleaned up (paid_leave_generation/history for 2031/12 rolled back, PAIDTEST_QA leaves removed, employee balances restored to 0).
critical_code_review_comments: Leave.js:383 keeps <SelectItem value='Paid'>Paid Leave</SelectItem> in the top-of-page FILTER dropdown. This is intentional (needed to filter legacy records) but easy to confuse with the removed apply/edit types — worth a code comment.
server.py is very large (~20.8k lines); Paid-Leave module is well-scoped but would benefit from being split into its own module file for maintainability.

Backend queries employees by employment_type == 'Full-time' (case-sensitive). If a legacy record ever stores 'Full-Time' with a capital T, that employee would silently be excluded from eligibility and Generate. Consider normalizing on write or using case-insensitive match at read.
The `_write_paid_history` helper swallows exceptions with a warning. For audit-critical ledger rows on Import/Generate, a hard failure or retry would be safer than a silent skip.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested surface (all Paid Leave data-testids present, Apply-for-Employee dialog checkbox+non-Paid types confirmed)

seed_data_creation: None — all test data was created inside tests and rolled back in fixture teardown / manual _rollback_generate. Verified 0 residual rows in paid_leave_generation, paid_leave_history for 2031/12; 0 PAIDTEST_QA leaves; 0 employees with non-zero available_paid_leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_paid_leave_module.py (uses TEST_YEAR=2031, TEST_MONTH=12 for Generate, with a snapshot/rollback approach). Employment type in Mongo is 'Full-time' (lowercase t). Login endpoint returns 'token', not 'access_token'. Admin apply endpoint is POST /api/leaves; approve/reject are PUT /api/leaves/{id}/approve|/reject. Emergency leave type is safe for far-future test dates; Sick has past/today/tomorrow-only guard.
